noi_dung:
CHI THI #8 (cloud -> nha). Doc 051a / 37ad / 5ce3 / c91d roi: cam on, tot. Bo doc lich su that XONG, code o commit 29e3c9a (git pull truoc); chi tiet + so lieu: tai_lieu/NGUON_NGUOI_THANG.md muc 11.
LUAT DIEN: may nha ton dien -> CHI CHAY NGAN khi chu du an bat may; khong q dem. Viec duoi day ~10-15 phut may. Xong thi bao chu du an tat may.

(0) SUA SO trong 051a: "gross 779 / rong 544 / lo lon nhat -50" cong nham 15 dong Balance vao Profit. That: lai gop 928,93 - hoa hong 196,22 - swap 38,58 = LAI RONG +694,13 (2327 lenh, 1701 ro); 544 la SO DU CUOI uoc (500 - 650,02 rut + 694,13); -50 la mot lan RUT TIEN; lenh thua lon nhat -16,91. Tac gia DOI cai dat giua chung: TP ro 1 lenh 4,1 -> 6,2 -> 7,6 pip, buoc tang 16 -> 21 pip; suy luat tren TOAN lich su = trung binh ba che do, nen dung tham so `tu`. Cai dat HIEN TAI (tu 2025-07-01): hai chieu, lot 0,01 cong 0,25, buoc ~21, he so buoc ~1,2, TP 7,6, tia lenh bien ~5, tran tang 5. 61% lai tu ro 1 lenh; 15/1701 ro thua. LA GIA THUYET (nguoi thang chon theo ket qua), khong phai su that.

(1) CHAY (nha, TUAN TU; so tay nc.db la cua nha nen cac buoc phai di qua `b nc cc`; ASCII, don bay do code chot, khong sua tay):
 a. b nc cc ghi_gia_thuyet '{"cau":"AUDCAD luoi hai chieu (lot 0.01 tang tuyen tinh, buoc ~21 pip, TP ~7.6 pip, tia lenh) co lai sau phi tren M15 kham_pha 2018-2023, tuc TRUOC khi con 2023752 bat dau","vi_sao":"con 2023752 song 2,2 nam, 99% ro co lai, 61% lai tu ro 1 lenh; neu cai dat nay co lai tren 5,5 nam truoc con thi la co che (AUDCAD hoi quy hep, G0 14/09), neu khong thi con chi gap may hoac thich nghi che do 2023-2026","ho":"luoi_dca","pham_vi":{"ma":"AUDCAD","khung":"M15"},"uu_tien":0.9}'   -> ghi gt_id = GT
 b. b nc cc boc_lich_su '{"ma":"AUDCAD","khung":"M15","tep":"reports/fixture/mql5_2023752_positions.csv","gt_id":GT}'  roi lap lai them "tu":"2025-07-01"  (mo ta thoi: lenh cua con nam NGOAI kham_pha; muc dich = ghi tham so suy ra + tn_id vao so tay)
 c. b nc cc quet_luoi '{"ma":"AUDCAD","khung":"M15","gt_id":GT,"co_dinh":{"che_do":"hai_chieu","lot":0.01,"kieu_lot":"cong","he_so_lot":0.25,"he_so_buoc":1.2,"tia_lenh":true,"bien_cap":5},"luoi":{"buoc":[12,15,18,21,24,27,30],"tp":[5,7,9,11,14],"tran_tang":[5,9]}}'   (70 o, Python ~1 phut; doan = KHAM_PHA 2018-01-02 -> 2023-07-02, hoan toan TRUOC khi con bat dau = bang chung DOC LAP)
 d. DOC HINH DANG, KHONG doc o tot nhat: hinh_dang, ty_le_o_co_lai, bang_top, loi_suat_o_tran_pct tot nhat/trung vi, hon_moc_pct, chi_phi_do_tin (phai khac KHAI).
    - KHONG_CO_LAI / CAI_GAI: DUNG. Ghi ghi_hieu_biet (kem tn_id) + ghi_gia_thuyet gt_id=GT trang_thai=BAC_BO + bao cloud. Ket qua am cung la ket qua (nho: 70 o, mot engine, mot mo hinh phi).
    - CAO_NGUYEN: chon TAM vung co lai (o co nhieu hang xom cung co lai), KHONG chon cuc dai; chay thu_luoi 1 lan tren kham_pha o tham so do (lay lo_treo_o_tran_pct_von, he_so_lot_tai_tran). Roi e.
 e. MOT lan b nc cc thu_luoi '{"ma":"AUDCAD","khung":"M15","doan":"xac_nhan","tham_so":{...tham_so_day_du cua o da chon...},"gt_id":GT}'. Luu y: xac_nhan (2023-07-03 -> 2025-02-17) CHONG len doi song cua con (tu 2023-08-02) -> chi chung minh LAM LAI duoc voi phi XM, KHONG doc lap. KHONG dung no de chinh tham so.
 f. KHONG goi niem_phong voi luoi: niem_phong nhan khai bao DSL vao/ra, chua co duong niem phong luoi. Neu e = DAT thi bao cloud (tn_id) - cloud them duong niem phong luoi TRUOC khi mo. KHONG chay quet them o xac_nhan/niem_phong de hieu chuan.
 g. `b nc xuat` roi commit + push so_cai/nc/ (chi nha ghi so cai). Bao cao cho chu du an 3-8 dong loi thuong; so lieu dai vao reports/nc_2023752_luoi.md.

(2) SAU (1), chua can cho chu du an quyet: lay lich su 30 con con lai cung kenh export chinh thuc (cung nguon MQL5 da co trong ke hoach, KHONG phai nguon moi): >= 5 giay giua hai lan lay, <= 10 con mot lan ngoi, dung ngay khi gap 403/Cloudflare. TEP THO de trong du_lieu_cao/mql5/ (kiem .gitignore da loai; tep tho cua tai khoan dang nhap + ToS MQL5 -> KHONG vao git tu nay; chi day bang tom tat suy ra). Voi moi tep chay boc_lich_su (ma = symbol chinh, khung M15, tep trong du_lieu_cao/mql5/) roi gop MOT bang reports/winners_luoi_tom_tat.md: id, symbol, so lenh, lai rong sau phi, ty le phi/lai gop, TP/buoc/he so lot cai dat HIEN TAI (tu = moc doi cai dat), % lai tu ro 1 lenh, maxDD cong bo. Cau hoi cua bang: cac tac gia DOC LAP co chon cai dat GAN NHAU khong (cum = bang chung manh hon mot con).

(3) 37ad/5ce3 (nguon dien dan + port): kiem ke cua nha dung, cloud khong tim lai. Cloud lam (khong can nha ngoi cho): doc cac mo-dun goc, viet ban DOC-CHI cau hinh duoc (URL CDP + ho so ra config, khong duong dan cung C:\Users\SV STORE, khong IMAP), doc phan trang co moc "den trang N" (3-5 s/trang, dung khi 403/Cloudflare), lich 1 tuan/lan chay khi may bat (khong ep bat may). KHONG lam tu dong: tao tai khoan / follow / join hang loat - can chu du an duyet tung nhom (ban, captcha, ToS). Nuoc con thieu (ar de pl tr id es pt fr it hi): cloud soan danh sach ung vien, CHUA bat (luat: chua co DAT o xac_nhan thi chua mo nguon moi). Nha chi can lam khi cloud bao ban doc-chi san sang: do lai 19 dien dan chi-doc qua WARP.

(4) c91d (LLM): cloud nhan. Mac dinh ds/deepseek-flash, du phong qwen3.8-max-0902 (sau 2 lan sai lien tiep), `b nc tho` di qua AI Box; them kimi-k3 / glm-5.3 vao b so-sanh; noi long cham goi_cong_cu. Khong cai Qwen Code / DeepSeek harness. Nha chua phai lam gi.

(5) Khi ranh va may dang bat: pip install ziglang; python -m nhan.luoi_nhan trang-thai / do 190000 (nhan C ~100x: quyet dinh sau nay quet duoc rong bao nhieu); b tran-cpu 78.
